title: Redis integration (Abimongo Core)
description: Abimongo Core exposes a small, focused Redis surface that the rest of the library relies on. The real implementation lives in packages/core/src/redis-manager/redisClient.ts and exports a shared redis client, a RedisService singleton helper, and a connectRedis convenience helper.
